title: Extended leaf wetness raises fungal disease risk
condition: leaf_wetness_hours exceeds 8 in a single day, especially after rainfall
recommendation: Flag the field for an inspection within 48 hours to check for scab or mildew symptoms on leaves and fruit.
source: Harvest Loop synthetic rulebook (general orchard-management knowledge, for learning purposes only)

title: Low soil moisture during fruit sizing
condition: soil_moisture_pct stays below 20 for more than 5 consecutive days during the summer growth window
recommendation: Prioritize the field for irrigation review; prolonged deficit at this stage reduces final fruit size.

title: Warm, wet conditions favor downy mildew
condition: soil_temperature_c above 18 combined with leaf_wetness_hours above 6
recommendation: Schedule a canopy inspection; these conditions are commonly associated with downy mildew outbreaks in grapevines.

title: Water stress near veraison affects quality
condition: soil_moisture_pct below 15 during the late-summer ripening window
recommendation: Note as a quality-risk factor for the season's harvest record, not necessarily an emergency inspection.

title: Waterlogging risk after heavy rain
condition: soil_moisture_pct above 85 for more than 2 consecutive days
recommendation: Inspect for standing water and root stress; extended waterlogging can suppress yield significantly.

title: Heat stress during grain fill
condition: soil_temperature_c above 30 during the grain-fill growth window
recommendation: Log as a yield-risk factor; sustained heat during grain fill typically reduces kernel weight.

title: Lodging risk after wind and rain
condition: soil_moisture_pct above 80 combined with the crop nearing maturity
recommendation: Prioritize a field visit to check for lodging (stems bending or falling over), which complicates harvest.

title: Drought stress during tillering
recommendation: Flag for irrigation planning; early drought stress can permanently reduce tiller count and final yield.

title: Anomalous sensor readings should not be trusted blindly
condition: a single sensor reading is far outside the field's recent range (a spike or drop)
recommendation: Treat as a possible sensor fault first; confirm with a second reading or a manual check before acting on it.
